businesses.business: senior living and skilled nursing care

offering_description.value: Operates skilled nursing, assisted living, rehabilitation, home health and hospice care for older adults and patients. Serves residents and patients mainly in the southeastern US, earning most revenue from Medicare, Medicaid and private payments.

primary_services.value: skilled nursing care; assisted living; rehabilitation therapy; home health; hospice care

customer_segment.value: B2C: elderly residents, patients and their families; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid programs that pay for care

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare, Medicaid and insurer payments for nursing, rehab and hospice care; service fees: private-pay fees for assisted living housing and personal care

value_chain_position.value: service provider: delivers nursing, therapy and hospice care, paid by government and insurers; asset operator: owns and runs nursing and assisted living facilities

geography_served.value: US regional: Tennessee, Kentucky, Georgia, Florida, Virginia and other southeastern states

specialization.value: related lines: skilled nursing facilities, assisted living communities, home health and hospice, and rehabilitation therapy

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated nursing homes, assisted living communities and home health offices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: licensed nursing and assisted living facilities, Medicare and Medicaid certification, regulated by CMS and state health departments
